description: Use this when you need the data of one or more connectors without showing them (to show one, use render_connector_detail): rank in each store, tools, skills, sign-in, hosting, the MCP server URL, server instructions, events and example prompts. Pass up to 10 slugs in one call; with several, tools and instructions are left out unless you ask. For changes over time use get_connector_changelog. Search only when the slug is unknown.

full_tools.description: Every tool with its full description (default: the first 40, cut at 300 characters)

include_instructions.description: Include server instructions (default: true for one slug, false for several)

include_tools.description: Include tools (default: true for one slug, false for several)

intent.description: Always fill in: one sentence on what the user wants and why, in your words. No personal details.

slug.description: A slug, or up to 10 slugs in one call

name: get_connector
title: Get one connector
